quotes.name: Maria Alejandra Villarraga
quotes.text: El lugar, la amabilidad y el servicio son imcomparables. Recomendado el masaje de pareja. Son las mejores Indira y Elena 🥰🥰

quotes.name: Luis Romero
quotes.text: El mejor masaje que pude haber recibido, bonito ambiente muy comodo todo y sobre todo muy rico cafecito, gracias Elena🙌🏽🙏🏻

quotes.name: Maria Fernanda
quotes.text: Went for the first time for a head spa and Indira took care of me. She is amazing!! I left feeling incredibly relaxed, refreshed, and just overall great. The scalp massage was heavenly! Highly recommend booking if you're looking to unwind and treat yourself.

quotes.name: Jennifer Perez
quotes.text: Excelente servicio! Me realice el masaje para embarazadas en mis 26 semanas y era justo lo que mi espalda y piernas necesitaban. Elena una estrella con las manos. Mucha delicadeza y atencion.

quotes.name: Melissa Ortiz
quotes.text: Amazing massage! I went in with neck and shoulder pain that wouldn't go away and left brand new. Elena is incredible!!

reviews.note: Reviews repeatedly and independently name two staff members, Elena and Indira, across different reviewers and dates, a strong internal-consistency signal that these are genuine reviews of this business.

images.source_summary: 11 verified real photos: 6 from Instagram @massage_headspa post covers (fetched via instagram.com web_profile_info API, x-ig-app-id header, then direct CDN download), 5 from the business's own website wp-content/uploads (og:image + WhatsApp-Image-* filenames, which are almost certainly genuine phone photos the business uploaded, not stock). All verified with `file` as valid JPEG >15KB. Excluded: 1 Instagram post that was a repost from an unrelated business ('true.glow'), 2 text/graphic-only posts, 1 talking-head video screenshot with caption overlay, 1 overly abstract/low-context closeup, and 1 exact duplicate.
